title: Contract Based Verification of Non-functional Requirements for Embedded Automotive C Code
abstract: arXiv:2605.21532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code contracts provide a robust way to specify functional requirements of safety-critical software in embedded systems. For example, the ANSI/ISO C Specification Language (ACSL) can be used to specify the functional behavior of C code that is then formally verified by the Frama-C framework's Wp plugin. However, non-functional requirements, such as restrictions on control flow and data flow, are also important for embedded systems safety. Untrusted code developed by subcontractors, junior developers, or generated by large language models, can be verified by Wp but may nevertheless call unsafe functions or use uninitialized program variables. To address this problem, we constructed a set of general rules concerning non-functional requirements of C code in safety-critical embedded systems. translated_title: 基于契约的嵌入式汽车C代码非功能需求验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.21532v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：代码契约为嵌入式系统中安全关键软件的功能需求提供了一种稳健的规范方式。例如，ANSI/ISO C规范语言（ACSL）可用于规范C代码的功能行为，随后由Frama-C框架的Wp插件进行形式化验证。然而，非功能需求（如对控制流和数据流的限制）对于嵌入式系统安全性同样重要。由分包商、初级开发人员或大型语言模型生成的不可信代码，可能通过Wp验证，但仍可能调用不安全函数或使用未初始化的程序变量。为解决此问题，我们构建了一套关于安全关键嵌入式系统中C代码非功能需求的通用规则。我们的规则与MISRA-C等流行C规则集正交，侧重于模块及其通过接口的交互。为启用检查...
tldr: 本文提出了一套针对安全关键嵌入式C代码的非功能需求通用规则，侧重于模块接口交互，以补充Wp插件功能验证的不足，增强对不可信代码的安全性检查。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a set of general rules for non-functional requirements of safety-critical embedded C code, focusing on module interface interactions, to complement Wp plugin functional verification and enhance safety checks for untrusted code.
